blocks.text: YKONE leads the client relationship and creative vision. NOYA brings the Egypt side to life: the places, the hospitality and the people on the ground, under YKONE’s name.

items.text: Brand campaigns and shoots built around your creative: location scouting, permit applications, local crew and equipment, unit moves and hospitality on set.

items.title: Production support
items.text: Scouting, permit applications, local crew, fixers and equipment, coordinated with your producers.

items.text: Hotels, buy-outs and private villas sourced and booked for your dates, from Cairo to the coast.

items.text: The right tables in Cairo and private dinners in settings chosen for the brief.

items.title: Events & hosted moments

items.title: Yachts & aviation

items.title: Local destination execution
items.text: One team on the ground and one point of contact, working under YKONE’s name.

blocks.text: Venues, access and dates are subject to permits, approvals and availability. NOYA confirms each before anything is presented to a client.

next.label: Next step
next.title: Send us the brief, dates and ambition. *We’ll build the Egypt layer around it.*
next.text: Reply to Adam directly. We come back with locations, logistics and a costed outline.
